Next to the manipulated "WITH," is the word "BANG." The whole phrase therefore is "start with a bang" and "end with a bang".

The description indicates that Node 1 (WITH) is before Node 2 (BANG) and they are NEXT-TO each other.  The highlight attribute on Node 1 indicates emphasis on what's before the word WITH, in this case the up and down arrows.

So, the answer is (B) start with a bang. It also contains “go out with a bang” but we choose “start with a bang” as it’s mentioned earlier.
